reviews.text:
A BIG THANK YOU to Austin with Two Sons Fencing. This is the second project they helped us with. The first one was with a fence extension and repairs, while talking to Austin we learned that their offer way more than fencing. In this occasion they helped us with upgrading the look to our front yard flower bed and tree. Austin took the time to listen to what we were looking for, after meeting with us and listening to his recommendations we put it on the schedule, his crew showed on time and finished the project on time.

Thank you for your time, patience, transparency and honesty.

GREAT JOB!!! We look forward to the next project.
reviews.author: Conrad Quinones

reviews.text:
Absolutely amazing experience from start to finish! The 2 sons crew tore down and rebuilt a masterpiece fence in 12hrs.
The crew was super friendly, on time and extremely tidy. I’m so so pleased with the service we got with this company. Look forward to more business in the future ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
reviews.author: Janine DeHoyos

reviews.text: Hired Two Sons Fence Company to repair our side gate. The latch rusted through and the hinges weren't properly aligned, making it a pain to close. They did an amazing job on the gate and it looks great now! Communication was easy and prompt, and we're planning to hire them for additional work.
reviews.author: Meghan Rieke

reviews.text: Two Sons Fencing did an awesome job on our backyard fence and built a great fence cover and walkway for our trash cans on the side of the house. Super professional, great quality, and everything looks perfect. If you’re looking for a reliable McKinney fence company, they’re the fence company McKinney homeowners should call!
reviews.author: Michael Young

reviews.text: From the first hand shake to the final walkthrough I had a great experience. After spending looking for the right fence company in McKinney, I had no doubt I picked the right guys for the job.They were so forthcoming, responsive, and made it easy on my end. Couldn’t be happier with my new fence! Their work speaks for itself. Thank y’all for the hassle free experience! 🙏🏻
reviews.author: Ashton Blackwood

reviews.text:
We couldn’t be happier with the beautiful fence that 2 Sons Fence Company built for our home. From the very first conversation to the final walk-through, their team was professional, friendly, and truly cared about getting every detail just right.
They treated our project as if it were their own — showing up on time, communicating clearly, and making sure the worksite was always tidy. The craftsmanship is outstanding; our new fence not only looks amazing but also gives our family and pets a real sense of privacy and security.
It’s rare to find a company that combines skill, honesty, and heart, but 2 Sons Fence Company absolutely does. We’re so grateful for their hard work and the pride they put into what they do. Highly recommend them to anyone looking for quality work and genuine people!
reviews.author: Ryan Murphy

reviews.text: I couldn’t be happier with the experience from start to finish! The team at Two Sons was professional, punctual, and truly cared about doing the job right. They took the time to understand what I wanted, offered helpful suggestions, and delivered a beautiful fence that completely transformed my yard. The workmanship is top-notch, and they left everything clean and neat when the job was done. It’s rare to find a company that combines great communication, fair pricing, and excellent quality but Two Sons does it all. Highly recommend to anyone looking for reliable fencing work!
reviews.author: Teresa Shea

reviews.text:
Absolutely Incredible Outdoor Transformation!
We are beyond thrilled with our new gate, fencing, patio, and outdoor kitchen! From the first consultation to the final walkthrough, the team was professional, knowledgeable, and easy to work with. They took our ideas and turned them into something even better than we imagined.

The attention to detail was unmatched — every cut, corner, and finish looks perfect. The gate and fencing add so much curb appeal, and the patio and outdoor kitchen have completely transformed our backyard into a space we love spending time in. The crew showed up on time each day, kept the area clean, and finished everything right on schedule.

It’s rare to find a company that delivers top-notch quality, clear communication, and genuine pride in their work. We couldn’t recommend them more — if you’re thinking about upgrading your outdoor space, this is the team to call!
reviews.author: Mary Kirby

data.summary: The reviews are highly detailed, specific, and varied in writing style, strongly indicating authentic customer experiences. The perfect 5.0 rating with 48 reviews is unusual but plausible for a high-quality, smaller local contractor. The lack of any negative reviews is the only minor point of caution, but the content of the positive reviews is very credible.
fake_signals: No negative or critical feedback found
authentic_signals: Specific project details (fence extension, gate repair, flower bed upgrade)
Varied writing styles and specific outcomes
Mention of multiple service types (fencing, landscaping)
